newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa tests 1,140 barrier, coffee higher AM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa tests 1,140 barrier, coffee higher AM.

text.p: COCOA - Sept steps back after a move above 1,140 stg resistance proved shortlived. Hits a high of 1,141 before trading unchanged at 1,130 at 1003 GMT.
COFFEE - Gaps higher in line with pre-market expectation but lacks stamina to motor much higher. Sept up $28 at $1,888.
SUGAR - Drifts lower in minimal trade. Awaits direction from New York. Aug down 30 cents at $323.00.
